verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs say its managed database APIs come "with permissions and realtime" and that apps can "respond to server events in realtime", so live updates are a first-party capability. The pack never documents the subscription mechanism itself: no channels, no client SDK subscribe call, and no database-change event payloads. A community comment refers to a WebSocket connection pool but notes there is no scaling documentation. Missing for 10: explicit docs on subscribing to row or collection change events from client SDKs, details of the realtime channel/subscription API, and hands-on or independent corroboration that UI updates arrive without polling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to live data changes so my UI updates in real time without polling
